# skycloak_siem_destinations (Data Source)

All SIEM forwarding destinations in the workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "skycloak_siem_destinations" "all" {}

output "unhealthy_destinations" {
  value = [for d in data.skycloak_siem_destinations.all.destinations : d.name if d.health_status != "healthy"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `destinations` (Attributes List) Destinations, with delivery health. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destinations))

<a id="nestedatt--destinations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `destinations`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether forwarding is active.
- `failure_count` (Number) Consecutive delivery failures.
- `health_status` (String) `healthy`, `degraded`, or `failed`.
- `id` (String) Destination ID (UUID).
- `last_error` (String) Most recent delivery error.
- `last_sent_at` (String) Last successful delivery.
- `name` (String) Destination name.
- `source_type` (String) Forwarded stream type.
- `total_bytes_sent` (Number)
- `total_events_sent` (Number)
- `total_logs_sent` (Number)
- `type` (String) Destination type: `syslog`, `s3`, or `http`.
- `updated_at` (String)
